control: append-only event id is monotonic
failure_boundary: Any gap or duplicate event number freezes packet claim

control: previous hash required after genesis
failure_boundary: Missing previous hash is a chain break

control: entry hash covers packet id, path, artifact hash, previous hash and clock
failure_boundary: Partial hash cannot prove receipt integrity

control: receipt hash cannot be reused across different packet IDs
public statement cannot be an append-chain event type that closes readiness
synthetic payload marker must propagate to chain row
failure_boundary: Synthetic contamination blocks live evidence credit

control: clock source and timezone must be explicit
delayed hash requires deferred-hash reason
failure_boundary: Delayed hash cannot prove original capture time

control: redacted surrogate hash must pair to original hash or explain absence
custody transfer must name from/to roles or redacted surrogates
failure_boundary: Ownerless transfer is a chain break

control: paper receipt may be logged but cannot close evidence
public-meeting audio/video/transcript intake has its own lockbox
failure_boundary: Meeting statements cannot close branch readiness

control: hash algorithm must be declared
chain root must be sealed before claim release
fork ID/base filename required for chain context
chain verification must be reproducible from package contents
operator receipt must be linked to packet and branch gate
counterevidence can append but not overwrite prior event
source cluster independence is counted once
failure_boundary: Duplicate source IDs do not corroborate

control: CAP/retest/verifier state is downstream of adjudication
public release manifest cannot modify chain history
failure_boundary: Release is egress, not evidence closure

control: emergency override requires post-event repair and claim freeze
